title: AutoTestRunner case
description: A test case: the steps a person takes, ending at a checkpoint.

name.description: What the case does, as the launcher lists it.

needs.description: The ids of the cases it carries on from (their file names without the number).

needsNote.description: What it needs, in words, for the launcher's Run after column, such as Any time.

covers.description: What it tries, for the launcher.

review.description: Why the case needs looking at again, such as a change to a case it carries on from. The launcher shows a warning on it until it is changed, or the warning is cleared.

target.description: A control: an element's name from elements.json, a selector, or a list of either to try in order.

id.description: Its AutomationId, which WPF takes from x:Name when none is set. Inside a template it repeats on every row.

name.description: Its name: a button's text, a box's label.

match.description: How name and helpText are compared. exact when left out.

within.description: Only looks inside this control, or with type Window, this window of the app's.

sameRowAs.description: Only controls on the same row as this one, such as the buttons beside a file's name.

scrollToFind.description: Scrolls the window's long lists until it is built, for lists that only build the rows in view.

button.description: Shorthand for type Button with this name.

text.description: Shorthand for type Text with this name.

edit.description: Shorthand for type Edit with this name.

tabItem.description: Shorthand for type TabItem with this name.

comboBox.description: Shorthand for type ComboBox with this name.

checkBox.description: Shorthand for type CheckBox with this name.

radioButton.description: Shorthand for type RadioButton with this name.

listItem.description: Shorthand for type ListItem with this name.

list.description: Shorthand for type List with this name.

window.description: Shorthand for type Window with this name.

say.description: What the panel says. On an action, it is shown before the action; on find, waitText and waitGone, after, with time to read it; alone, it is narration.

note.description: For whoever maintains the script. Not shown.

as.description: Keeps what the step found or printed in a variable of this name, as ${name} and ${name.part}.

what.description: What to call the control in a message, such as "the start screen".

within.description: How long to wait, in seconds, before it counts as stuck. An unattended run triples it.

startApp.description: Closes any copy of the app, starts it, and places it beside the panel.
